set.body:
Phase: core. Journey: Open. Track: engine.

Outcome
One server read says whether a release is ready to publish and, if not, exactly why. The console (OPEN6) and the publishing tool (OPEN2) both use it.

Acceptance
1. A readiness read for a release returns a list of checks. Each passes, fails, or needs a person, and names the file and field concerned:
   - Description: Name, Authors and a README longer than a stub; Funding, EthicsApprovals and HowToAcknowledge where they apply.
   - Licence: present and one of the allowed values (OPEN0), which come from configuration.
   - Structure: no error findings in Sanctity. The official BIDS validator runs when the package is built (OPEN2).
   - Dictionaries: participants.json is present; every phenotype table has a dictionary; columns without a description are listed.
   - De-identification, automatic: no sidecar fields from a deny list (PatientName, PatientBirthDate, AcquisitionDateTime and the like); no date-like columns in participant tables; ages above 89 flagged.
   - De-identification, attested: structural images defaced (tool and date); free-text columns reviewed; consent and the ethics protocol permit open release.
2. Attestations are a small file with a documented format, sourcedata/sanctity/publication-readiness.json. It enters the dataset through the normal correction flow, so the acceptance record shows who attested and when. It is left out of the public package.
3. Readiness is computed from the release itself. It is therefore bound to that exact release, every steward sees the same answer, and there is no new stored state.
4. Only callers who may read the release's metadata get the read.
5. Tests cover one failing and one passing fixture for each check.

Not in scope
The screen (OPEN6). Defacing images. Automatic face detection. Minting DOIs.

Start from
- modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/ArchiveInterpreter.scala line 91: the License and DatasetDOI fields.
- modules/http/src/main/scala/sanctity/http/RepositoryHttp.scala line 180: the metadata read.

Evidence
Unit and HTTP tests. The Open step of CORE1.
set.title: OPEN1: Publication readiness, computed by the server
